movie_disc_init_integration.next_task: Qualify remaining initializer, directory-loader and path-resolution branches using original code and explicit media/failure inputs. movie_disc_init_integration.scope: Seven closed wrapper, sector, signature, endian, lookup and version bodies qualify: every own row and outcome executes across main/descriptor comparisons. Seven canonical helpers are reused without extra credit. The original cold earlier caller initializes its filesystem from real media and returns; three larger parents remain partial.
limitations: The direct profiles declare their own contexts, descriptors, strings, directory records, buffers and software hardware observations. Actual cold initialization clears only the two filesystem/interface roots before executing original producers; no filesystem header, directory result, callback or success value is inserted.

The earlier common RAM seed contains a prepared filesystem at 8cc80000. Its warm profile reads no media and returns guest -8; it is retained separately, not presented as fresh filesystem initialization. Cold filesystem/interface roots are explicitly zero, matching their original word values.

The cold earlier caller creates filesystem root 8c6946e0, performs 72 real track-sector reads, sets its original initialized flag and returns guest zero after 1345913 ordinary original steps plus the retained full-clear decoder. All 56648 ordinary service boundaries and final complete state match. These are explicit profiles, not physical Dreamcast timing or complete natural reset-to-main ordering.

Direct small-capacity contexts legitimately return guest -12 with two reads; misaligned contexts return -14, injected transport failures return -4 and already-initialized contexts return zero. Host zero means the original routine returned normally, not that its guest operation succeeded.

Direct tests use the retained explicitly prepared library seed and initialize its linked temporary descriptor as a precondition. They do not claim that every context was constructed by original reset flow. The preceding 170-source cold initialization proof remains retained separately.

The suite covers nested/missing/case-folded names, both separators, prefixed paths, record rollover and exact sector ends, cache hits, signed counts, buffer-full and first-record size changes, read failures, table selection and type-one post-processing. Independent namespace/record/hash/field assertions supplement full-state instruction comparisons.

The one unexecuted outcome would branch on R11 equal to one after a dominating check established the opposite. The intervening corridor, its delay slots and its original comparison/uppercase callees preserve R11. The proof assumes immutable instructions, normal call/return ABI and no asynchronous CPU register mutation. Every original row and branch remains in C.

An out-of-range path-table input retains the previous finite read-wait stop. Four invalid-memory controls match; a leaf helper that never accesses its stack can still return normally with a bad-stack fixture. Host zero is not synonymous with guest operation success.

The new build directly replays retained warm earlier startup and its complete eight-MiB clear. The original bridge is byte-identical after removing only added routes/export renames, and the earlier 56648-boundary cold trace has none of those routes. This is source-level preservation evidence; that entire cold comparison was not rerun in the new DLL.
